summary: THE JOINT'S GEOMETRY IS MEASURED ON BOTH SIDES. The ring: cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders + bbox on seeed_bearing__configuration__22x16x4.stl reads hole Ø16.0 / boss Ø22.0 / 22.0 x 22.0 x 4.0 (frozen in the artifact), placed x11 (trunk_base x2, yaw2roll, hip_l x2, upper_leg L+R, neck_pitch, yaw_roll_motion x2, bearing_roll — spec/mesh-placements.json). The seats: yaw2roll 'yaw_bearing_seat' Ø16.0 x 1.95 boss with its own Ø19.0 x 0.5 shoulder (inner ring), hip-bracket Ø16.0 x 1.95, yaw-roll-motion Ø16.0 x 4.0, each measured in its own part folder off Pollen's meshes. compat.py graded the real yaw2roll pair live: interface_names, nominal_size and abutment PASS, the rest honestly open. No vendor designation exists in the reference for this ring and none was invented.
by: claude (microduck connections lane), meshfeatures + interface scan

summary: ISO 286 LIMITS DERIVED AND CHECKED, WITH A MEASURED TABLE DRIFT RECORDED. From ISO 286-1's own formulae (i = 0.45*cbrt(D)+0.001*D, IT6 = 10i, k: ei = +0.6*cbrt(D)) the module reproduces published 16 k6 (+1/+12), 16 h6 (-11/0) and 22 k6 (+2/+15) exactly. The published IT7 at 10-18 (18 um) sits 1 um above raw 16i (17.32) — the same ISO 286-2 table drift press-fit-bearing-15x10x3 measured — so it is TRANSCRIBED in compat.PUBLISHED_IT7_UM with this row as the record; at 18-30 the formula's 20.93 rounds to the published 21 on its own. Self-test PASS after the transcription.

THE INTERFERENCE IS UNMEASURED AND STAYS SO, three named gaps: (1) the seats are FDM-printed PLA — a printed bore has no ISO class, slicer compensation moves a Ø22 pocket by more than an IT7 band; calipers on the as-printed seat (measured_d_mm) complete the fit check. (2) the unnamed ring has no vendor tolerance sheet to fetch; calipers on the actual ring (ring_deviation_um) complete the envelope. (3) partial engagement: Pollen's own bosses are 1.95 mm for the 4 mm ring (~49% engagement) so the ring spans the joint gap to the mating part — whether that holds the press is a bench question; compat reports the ratio and refuses both verdicts.
